statement: This sketch presents a surreal, crystalline architecture where geometric shards float in an infinite void. The composition is built from hundreds of individually rotating crystal forms that emit delicate stress fracture lines—thin, tension-filled paths that trace through space like internal fault lines. Each shard is composed of simple polygonal facets that rotate slowly over time, creating a sense of structural instability and constant reconfiguration. The stress lines propagate dynamically across the canvas, their persistence suggesting an ongoing, catastrophic failure of form. The viewer witnesses an architectural collapse in slow motion, where each fragment seems to adjust and reposition itself under immense internal strain.
